notes.title: BIG UPDATE
notes.content:
[h2][b]New Content:[/b][/h2]

[b]New Enemies:[/b]
[list]
[*] Dark Knight
[*] Jack o' Lantern
[*] 3 New Super Bosses in NG+
[/list]
[b]Visual Enhancements:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added Icons for Items, Skills, Dark Arts, and Key Items
[*] Added Icons in Shops and Bank Interface
[*] Indicator for Available Ability Points
[/list]
[b]New Game Plus:[/b]
[list]
[*] Exclusive Weapons Obtainable from Super Bosses
[*] Enhanced Difficulty for a More Challenging Experience
[*] Addition of a Berries Seller
[/list]
[b][h2]Gameplay Adjustments:[/h2][/b]
[b]Enemy Tweaks:[/b]
[list]
[*] Stats Adjustments for Some Enemies
[*] Required Experience Point Adjusted
[/list]
[b]Skill Adjustments:[/b]
[list]
[*] Skill "Last Hope" Enhanced
[*] Punching Skills No Longer Apply Weapon Effects
[*] Dark Sword Now Applies Weapon Effects
[/list]
[b]Weapon Enhancements:[/b]
[list]
[*] Improved Effects for Select Weapons:
[list]
[*] Poison Knife
[*] Timeless Sword
[*] Assassin Knife
[*] Destroyer
[/list]
[/list]
[b]General Adjustments:[/b]
[list]
[*] Bank Gold Limit Set at 9,999,999
[*] Tunnel Cart Construction Time Reduced to 2 Days After Meeting Conditions (from 5 days)
[*] Elemental Damage Reduction
[/list]
[h2][b]Bug Fixes:[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Equipment Position Memory Issue Resolved
[*] Speed Stat Reduction Under Certain Conditions Fixed
[*] Ferock Blacksmith's Shining pendant Crafting Now Available After Day XX
[*] Dark Arts Improvement Now Accessible After Day XX
[/list]

notes.title: Updates notes for April 6th.
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Increased bats amount in caves.
[*] Fixed end game achievements that were not unlocking properly.
[*] Fixed Minecart extension in New Game+ mode that was appearing instantly without doing the quest.
[*] Corrected cat names in a particular quest.
[*] Fixed an issue with the Auction on day 50 and 51 where the item notice was not displaying correctly.
[*] Removed item "Dark Tears" entirely from the game as it kept appearing while fishing.
[*] Addressed a bug that was causing the Ceres item shop to close early and kick players out before the posted closing time.
[/list]

notes.title: Updates Notes April 4th.
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Big Bombs are now available at Ferrock Shop!
[*] Improved Lantern sprite for easier visibility.
[*] Translation issues have been fixed.
[*] Resolved bug in New Game+where players could improve dark skills multiple times.
[/list]

notes.title: Updates for Apr 1st
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added a new configuration option to the start screen
[*] Resolved an issue that previously prevented users from taking screenshots within the application.
[*] Addressed several other minor issues and bugs
[/list]
